title.zh: Meta推出Muse Image和Muse Video生成模型
title.en: Meta launches Muse Image in Meta AI, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and previews Muse Video, the first media generation models from its Superintelligence Labs

summary.zh: Meta在Meta AI、Instagram和WhatsApp中推出Muse Image，并预览了来自其超级智能实验室的首个媒体生成模型Muse Video。

title.zh: 消息称中国与多家科技公司讨论限制AI模型外部访问
title.en: Sources: China met with Alibaba, ByteDance, Z.ai, and others to discuss potentially limiting foreign access to advanced AI models, penalties for AI theft, more

summary.zh: 中国与阿里巴巴、字节跳动、Z.ai等公司讨论限制外国访问先进AI模型的可能性，并探讨AI盗窃的惩罚措施等。

title.zh: Anthropic扩展Claude Cowork至网页和移动端
title.en: Anthropic expands Claude Cowork to web and mobile in beta for Max plan subscribers, and says 90%+ of Cowork usage is unrelated to software development

summary.zh: Anthropic宣布在Max计划订阅者中测试Claude Cowork的网页和移动端版本，并表示90%以上的使用与软件开发无关。

title.zh: 顶级AI实验室争夺B2B收入，向初创公司提供激励
title.en: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other top AI labs are offering startups token credits, promotions, and one-time bonuses as they battle for lasting streams of B2B revenue

summary.zh: OpenAI、Anthropic等顶级AI实验室向初创公司提供代币积分、促销和一次性奖金，以争夺长期的B2B收入来源。

title.zh: 消息称微软用自家MAI模型替代OpenAI和Anthropic模型
title.en: Sources: Microsoft, looking to reduce AI costs, is starting to replace models from OpenAI and Anthropic with its MAI models in products like Excel and Outlook

summary.zh: 微软为降低AI成本，开始在Excel和Outlook等产品中用其MAI模型替代OpenAI和Anthropic的模型。

title.zh: 亚马逊计划通过美元债券筹资至少250亿美元
title.en: Sources: Amazon is looking to raise at least $25B from a US dollar bond sale to fund its AI infrastructure investments; the size could increase based on demand

title.zh: 联合国秘书长呼吁禁止“杀手机器人”
title.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls for autonomous “killer robots” to be “banned by international law”, a central issue in the US DOD-Anthropic clash

summary.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯呼吁通过国际法禁止“杀手机器人”，这是美国国防部与Anthropic冲突的核心问题之一。

title.zh: Anthropic计划扩展纽约团队至1000人
title.en: Anthropic plans to lease a 16-story building in Lower Manhattan and double its NYC workforce to 1,000 people this year, as AI companies expand in the city

summary.zh: Anthropic计划租赁曼哈顿一栋16层大楼，并在今年将其纽约团队规模扩大至1000人。

title.zh: 欧洲银行监管机构警告前沿AI模型的系统性风险
title.en: European banking watchdogs ECB and ESRB warn that frontier AI models pose “systemic risks to the financial system”, and give lenders four months to prepare

summary.zh: 欧洲央行和欧洲系统性风险委员会警告前沿AI模型对金融系统的系统性风险，并要求贷款机构在四个月内做好准备。

title.zh: Keyfactor完成10亿美元融资
title.en: Keyfactor, which manages billions of machine identities for more than 2,500 client organizations, raised $1B+ led by Summit Partners

summary.zh: Keyfactor为超过2500家客户组织管理数十亿机器身份，此次融资由Summit Partners领投。

title.zh: 慕尼黑核聚变初创公司Proxima Fusion融资4.11亿欧元，估值24亿欧元
title.en: Munich-based nuclear fusion startup Proxima Fusion raised €411M led by trading firm XTX and UK-based East X at a €2.4B valuation, with participation from Google

summary.zh: 由交易公司XTX和英国East X领投，Google参与。

title.zh: AI法律服务公司Norm融资1.2亿美元，估值12亿美元
title.en: Norm, which runs an AI law firm that provides AI-powered legal services to clients alongside human lawyers, raised $120M led by Khosla at a $1.2B valuation

summary.zh: 由Khosla领投，Norm结合AI与人类律师提供法律服务。

title.zh: 英国AI基础设施初创公司Nscale获得9亿美元信贷额度
title.en: UK-based AI infrastructure startup Nscale secures a $900M line of credit to expand its data center buildout across Europe, the US, and Asia-Pacific

summary.zh: 资金将用于扩展其在欧洲、美国和亚太地区的数据中心建设。

title.zh: 博通与苹果延长合作至2031年，共同开发定制芯片
title.en: Broadcom, Apple Extend Tie-Up to 2031 With New Custom Chips (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 合作涉及多代苹果产品的ASIC芯片开发，支持AI相关任务处理。
summary.en: Broadcom and Apple have expanded their partnership through to 2031. The companies are working together to develop application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) silicon for multiple generations of Apple products. ASIC chips are increasingly vital to the development of components for processing artificial intelligence-related tasks. Apple plans to deploy its advanced AI servers as early as 2027.

title.zh: Anthropic研究揭示语言模型中的“J空间”概念
title.en: A global workspace in language models (26 minute read)

summary.zh: J空间是Claude内部神经模式，支持推理、调节思维和解决多步问题。
summary.en: Anthropic's new research paper introduces the concept of "J-space" in language models, revealed as internal neural patterns playing a unique role in Claude's processing. Emerging during training without explicit design, the J-space allows Claude to internally reason, modulate thoughts, and solve multi-step problems, distinguishing them from automatic processes. These patterns enable the monitoring of internal thoughts for AI misbehavior and provide insights into AI consciousness, suggesting a tangible distinction between deliberate and automatic decisions.

title.zh: 企业AI中的开源模型：现状与未来趋势
title.en: Everyone Is Wrong About Open Source AI in the Enterprise (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 企业AI部署初期倾向于使用开源模型，未来可能转向专用开源替代方案。
summary.en: Decagon runs roughly 90% of its workloads on open-source models because small, heavily fine-tuned models deliver the latency and task-specific performance required for customer service agents. Most enterprise AI use cases remain early-stage, so companies favor frontier models that maximize flexibility and intelligence. As deployments mature and workflows stabilize, many production workloads will likely migrate from closed models to specialized open-source alternatives.

title.zh: 数据成为战略资产：数据实验室支出预计2030年超1000亿美元
title.en: A Stargate for Data (6 minute read)

summary.zh: 随着AI训练对高质量私有数据需求增加，数据收集成为关键瓶颈。
summary.en: Data Labs are projected to surpass $100B/year in data spend by 2030 as demand shifts from compute-limited to data-limited regimes. The bottleneck now lies in collecting private, high-quality datasets, as public internet data becomes insufficient for AI training needs. This scarcity positions data as a strategic asset pivotal to economic and scientific progress, potentially spurring efforts to cultivate new data sources akin to major compute investments.

title.zh: 腾讯发布2950亿参数Mixture-of-Experts模型Hy3
title.en: Hy3 (1 minute read)

summary.zh: Hy3性能超越同类模型，可免费在OpenRouter上使用至7月21日。
summary.en: Hy3 is a 295-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21 billion active parameters and 3.8 billion MTP layer parameters. Developed by Tencent, Hy3 outperforms similar-sized models and rivals flagship open-source models with two to five times more parameters. The full-sized model is available on Hugging Face. It is available for free on OpenRouter until July 21.

title.zh: PyTorch Monarch支持AMD GPU上的弹性分布式训练
title.en: Bringing PyTorch Monarch to AMD GPUs: Single-Controller Distributed Training on ROCm (13 minute read)

summary.zh: Monarch实现了在硬件故障情况下动态恢复，提升大规模AI基础设施稳定性。
summary.en: Training state-of-the-art large language models with billions of parameters requires distributed training across hundreds or thousands of GPUs. At this scale, hardware failures are expected. PyTorch Monarch enables elastic, fault-tolerant distributed training on AMD GPUs. This post shows how Monarch dynamically recovers from node failures without halting the entire job and why this represents a significant step toward stable large-scale AI infrastructure.

title.zh: PACE框架：代理能力评估的高效代理
title.en: PACE: A Proxy for Agentic Capability Evaluation (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 通过少量评估实例预测代理基准性能，降低99%以上评估成本。
summary.en: PACE framework predicts costly agentic LLM benchmark performance using a small subset of atomic evaluation instances, achieving high accuracy at a fraction of the cost. It uses a regression model with selected instances from non-agentic benchmarks to predict scores on agentic benchmarks. PACE reduces evaluation costs by over 99% while maintaining a mean absolute error under 4%, aiding model development and selection.

title.zh: 苹果前高管创立的中国智能眼镜公司成独角兽，腾讯和美团领投
title.en: Apple veteran's Chinese smart-glasses firm becomes unicorn as Tencent, Meituan fund rival to Meta (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 由前苹果高管王威创立的Even Realities Technology通过腾讯和美团领投的1.5亿美元融资，成功跻身独角兽行列。
summary.en: Even Realities Technology, founded by ex-Apple exec Will Wang, has reached unicorn status thanks to a $150 million funding round led by Tencent and Meituan.

title.zh: Fable与GPT 5.6时代的100倍生产力工程师画像
title.en: What The New 100x Agentic Engineer Looks Like In The Era Of Fable & GPT 5.6 (35 minute read)

summary.zh: 探讨了在代理工程领域中，如何培养出生产力远超平均水平的顶尖工程师。
summary.en: There are levels to the art of agentic engineering that result in outlier agentic engineers with orders of magnitude more productivity than the median.
